name: item
purpose: Versatile flex row for title, description, media, and actions. Mirrors the shadcn-vue Item anatomy so consumers can reorder or omit regions. Compose with `ItemGroup` for gapped off-card lists, `ItemList` for divided in-card lists (inside a `Card`), and `ItemSeparator` between rows. Reference: https://www.shadcn-vue.com/docs/components/item (adapted to Webkit tokens and naming).
useWhen: A row that pairs a title and description with leading media (icon, avatar, image) and trailing actions — settings entries, team members, next steps, notifications.
A list of such rows: `Item.Group` for gapped rows off a card, `Item.List` for divided rows inside a `card`.
A whole row that is one link or button — set `href` and the row renders as an anchor, or set `clickable` and bind `@click` and it renders as a native button.

A compact option in a chooser list (a workload, a host, an application picked under a search field): `kind="option"` with `clickable`, so the row is a native button. The row is 38 px — `--spacing-xs` block padding, `--spacing-sm` inline padding and gap, the title at `text-body-md` — and paints `var(--bg-selected)` when the row is `aria-pressed="true"` or `aria-selected="true"`.
avoidWhen: Records that share columns and need sorting, selection or paging → use `table`.
Hierarchical navigation rows in a sidebar → use `menu`.
A grid of selectable option cards → use `radio-cards`.
A single surface that frames arbitrary content → use `card`.
related: card` — the surface an `Item.List` sits in (with `:padded="false"`).
table` — columnar data; below `sm`, `listing-table` swaps its table rows for `item` rows.
menu` — navigation rows with nesting and drill levels.
avatar` — the usual leading media for people rows inside `Item.Media`.
bestPractices: Use `Item.Group` off-card and `Item.List` inside a `card` with `:padded="false"`; both force their child items' `kind` (`inline` in a group, `default` in a list), so do not set `kind` on rows inside them.
Item.List` draws its own dividers — do not add `Item.Separator` inside it.
With `href` or `clickable` the whole row is one focusable control with the row's hover, active and focus ring, so do not also put buttons or links inside that row.
Set `Item.Media` `kind="icon"` for a glyph and `kind="image"` for a picture; the frame sizes and clips the content.
Use `size="small"` for dense lists; `medium` is the default.

For the rows of a picker under a search field use `kind="option"` (not `size="small"` plus your own padding): it sets its own density and the selected fill from `aria-pressed` / `aria-selected`, so `size` does not change it. Keep option rows in a plain column, not in `Item.List` or `Item.Group`, which force their own kind.

props.name: kind
props.doc: Item root surface variant. `inline` removes the row's outer padding (transparent surface) for inline placement and divided in-card lists. `option` is a compact chooser row (38 px, title at body-md) that fills when its element is pressed or selected.

props.name: href
props.doc: When set, the whole row renders as an anchor link to this URL.

props.name: clickable
props.doc: Renders the whole row as a button; bind the click handler on the Item. Ignored when href is set.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: Every sub-component exposes `default` for its region.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import Item from '@aziontech/webkit/item'
</script>

<template>
  <Item>
    <Item.Content>
      <Item.Title>Basic Item</Item.Title>
      <Item.Description>A simple item with title and description.</Item.Description>
    </Item.Content>
    <Item.Actions>
      <Button
        label="Action"
        kind="outlined"
        size="small"
      />
    </Item.Actions>
  </Item>
</template>
